ModMetaData.name: Gendered Beds
ModMetaData.author: guska
ModMetaData.description:
Restrict any bed to male or female pawns, so you can set up male and female dorms, gendered barracks or gendered prison cells.
Select one or more beds and use the "Gender" button to choose Any gender, Male only or Female only. Beds default to Any gender, so nothing changes until you set a restriction.
Restricted beds: - won't be claimed by, or assigned to, pawns of the wrong gender - won't be used when rescuing, capturing or carrying pawns to bed - unassign current owners who no longer match
Mod options: - Genderless pawns may use gendered beds (default: on) - Medical beds respect the restriction (default: off, so medical beds take anyone) - Show a gender icon on restricted beds (default: on)
Safe to add to an existing save. Requires Harmony. No DLC needed.
